errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

validation.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.
validation.phone: Enter a Saudi mobile number (05… or +9665…).
validation.contact: Add a phone number or an email.
validation.url: Enter a full URL starting with https://.
validation.prompt: Describe the topic in at least 20 characters.
validation.script: The script needs at least 20 characters.
validation.scriptMax: Keep the script under 900 characters (about 60 seconds).
validation.cutLength: A cut must be between 10 and 90 seconds.

auth.title: Sign in to the console
auth.subtitle: We send a one-time code to your work email.
auth.codeSentTo: Enter the code we sent to {email}.
auth.workspaceHint: The short name of your company space, for example alwadi.
auth.mockHint: Demo: use admin@alwadi.example (admin), khalid@alwadi.example (manager) or hana@alwadi.example (SME).

signup.title: Create your workspace
signup.subtitle: One minute to set up. You will confirm your email with a code.
signup.slugHint: Used in links and sign-in. Lowercase, no spaces.
signup.slugTaken: That workspace code is already in use.
signup.regionHint: Where your data lives. Cannot be changed later.
signup.privacyNote: Managers see readiness per topic; HR sees hours on mandatory topics. Nobody sees individual answers.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: How the company is learning this period.
dashboard.recallHint: Answers remembered on the spaced check
dashboard.hrdfHint: Minutes on mandatory topics, as hours
dashboard.activityHint: Active learners per day and recall over time
dashboard.noActivity: No activity in this period yet.
dashboard.attentionHint: Things that are waiting on you
dashboard.chartLabel: Active learners per day with recall percentage

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Integrations, delivery, data residency and credits.
settings.secretsWriteOnly: Secrets are stored encrypted and never shown again.

residency.title: Data residency
residency.hint: Your region is enforced by deployment, not by policy text.
residency.note: Reels, captions and uploads stay in the region's storage. Exports are signed links that expire.

credits.title: Credits
credits.hint: Generation is priced before it runs; the storyboard is reviewable before any render spend.

delivery.cadenceHint: A minute a day: two new reels and up to one review.
delivery.windowsHint: Reels only arrive inside these windows, never in prayer times or after hours.
delivery.noWindows: No windows yet. Add one so deliveries can start.
delivery.prayerAwareHint: Skip the five prayer times for the learner's city

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every write, with who did it and what changed.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: By topic, by group, and the HRDF evidence pack.
reports.privacyNote: Reports are aggregates by day. They never contain which answer a learner chose or when they watched.
reports.evidenceHint: Hours on mandatory topics per learner, with reel titles and compliance tags, as a signed download.
reports.noExportsHint: Build a pack for a period to get a signed download link.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Everyone who learns, manages or reviews.
people.emptyHint: Clear a filter, invite someone or import a CSV.
people.name: Name
people.inviteHint: They get a WhatsApp or email invite with a one-time code.

import.title: Import people from CSV
import.hint: Preview first. Nothing is written until you confirm.
import.serverDryRun: Server dry run finished. Nothing was written.

groupsPanel.title: Groups
groupsPanel.hint: Topics are assigned to groups. HRIS sync keeps location and team groups fresh.
groupsPanel.name: Name

hris.title: HRIS sync log
hris.hint: Nightly sync from your HR system. New joiners are invited; leavers are deactivated.
hris.emptyHint: Connect Jisr or Bayzat in Settings to start nightly sync.

topics.title: Topics and channels
topics.subtitle: Who gets which topic, how many reels a day, and on which channel.
topics.emptyHint: Create a topic, then assign it to groups.
topics.matrixHint: Tick a cell to assign. Open details to set cadence, channel and start date.
topics.footnote: Learners in several groups get the higher cadence, never the sum.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.complianceHint: Appears in HRDF and audit exports, e.g. HRDF-SAF or SAMA-AML.
dialog.mandatoryHint: Counts toward HRDF hours and is never skipped by the learner.

library.title: Reel library
library.subtitle: Every reel, its status and what it is waiting on.
library.emptyHint: Change a filter, or make new reels from a source.

studio.title: AI Reel Studio
studio.subtitle: From a source to reviewed reels in minutes.

newSource.title: Pick a source
newSource.subtitle: A handbook, a web page, a talk, or just a topic. Claude extracts the key ideas first; nothing is rendered yet.
newSource.fileHint: PDF, slides, image, audio or video up to 200 MB. Scanned PDFs are OCR'd.
newSource.unsupported: That file type is not supported. Use PDF, PPTX, PNG/JPG, MP3/M4A/WAV or MP4/MOV.
newSource.youtubeHint: If the video has no captions we transcribe it (a few minutes longer).
newSource.urlHint: Pages that block robots cannot be read; paste the text as a prompt instead.
newSource.promptHint: What should people remember? One paragraph is enough.
newSource.uploadFailed: The upload did not complete. Try again.

studio.jobsHint: Each job is priced before it runs.
studio.noJobsHint: Pick a source to start the first one.
studio.sourcesHint: Documents, links, talks and prompts you have brought in.

setup.title: Generation setup
setup.subtitle: Choose languages, count and style. You see the price before anything runs.
setup.languagesHint: The first language is the narration; others are dubbed with captions.

styleHints.ai_avatar: A presenter speaks to camera. Best for people topics.
styleHints.motion: Generated scenes with narration. Best for processes.
styleHints.broll: Stock footage, captions and voice. Lowest cost.

setup.reviewerHint: Gets a review request when the storyboard is ready
setup.briefHint: Tone, must-include points, words to avoid.
setup.quoteHint: Credits are reserved when you start and refunded if a step fails permanently.
setup.confirm: I have checked the quote and want to start

progress.title: Generating
progress.pausedHint: The provider is down. The job resumes on its own; no credits are lost.

storyboard.title: Storyboard
storyboard.subtitle: {n} reels · {credits} credits spent. Review scripts and questions, then send to review.
storyboard.emptyHint: The job has not produced reels. Check its progress.
storyboard.statusLegend: Reels in "{status}" wait for L&D and SME approval on the publish page.
storyboard.question: Recall question
storyboard.noQuestion: No question yet. Add one in the editor.

moments.title: Find the moments
moments.aiMomentsHint: Ranked by how self-contained and practical each segment is.
moments.noMomentsHint: Transcription may still be running. Check back in a few minutes.
moments.transcriptHint: Select a timestamp to move the start of the cut.
moments.cutHint: Trim to 10–90 seconds, confirm consent, and we make a draft.
moments.consent: The speaker consents to this cut being published
moments.pickFirstLong: Choose a suggested moment or a line in the transcript to start a cut.

editor.publishedNote: This reel is published. Saving creates a new version and sends it back to review; learners who saw the current version keep their memory state.
editor.scriptHint: One idea, one example, one line to remember. About 60 seconds.
editor.title: Title
editor.citationHint: Shown to learners under "why am I seeing this"
editor.question: Recall question
editor.questionHint: Three options, one correct. The learner sees the right answer afterwards; never a red cross.
editor.correctHint: Select the radio next to the correct option.
editor.previewHint: What the learner sees. Updates as you type.
editor.savedNewVersion: Saved as a new version and sent back to review

publish.approvalsHint: Both L&D and the subject expert must approve this version.
publish.audienceHint: Groups that receive this reel in their daily minute.
publish.startsOnHint: First delivery on or after this date

topics.title: Topics and people
topics.subtitle: Start from a sector template and bring people in from your HR system or a CSV.
topics.templatesHint: Pick the ones that apply; you can rename them later.
topics.peopleHint: Import from Jisr or Bayzat, upload a CSV with a preview, or invite one person.
topics.privacy: Managers will see readiness per topic and team averages. HR sees hours on mandatory topics. Nobody sees individual answers, saved reels or watch times.

delivery.title: Delivery and schedule
delivery.subtitle: When reels arrive. Shift windows, prayer and Ramadan awareness, and the daily cadence.
delivery.channelNote: Channel per group (app, WhatsApp or both) is set on the Topics page when you assign a topic.
